info.name: Food Delivery & Logistics API
info.description: All actual OpenAPI operations, with role-specific Bearer variables and state progression examples. Import the Local environment, provision privileged users through trusted setup, populate their user IDs/email/password privately, register/login a customer, and execute the selected workflow in README order. Do not run every mutation sequentially: checkout aliases, assignment aliases, failure, refunds, and deletes are alternative scenarios.
